title.value: Does Generative AI speak Nigerian-Pidgin?: Issues about Representativeness and Bias for Multilingualism in LLMs
title.justification: The abstract and introduction of the paper directly discuss how Generative AI models represent or fail to represent Nigerian Pidgin, focusing on issues of representativeness and bias in multilingual settings.
title.quote: Does Generative AI speak Nigerian-Pidgin?: Issues about Representativeness and Bias for Multilingualism in LLMs

analysis.description: The paper investigates the representation and bias issues of Nigerian Pidgin in generative AI models, especially within large language models (LLMs). Through statistical analyses and machine translation experiments, it shows linguistic differences between West African Pidgin English (WAPE) and Nigerian Pidgin (Naija) and explores the underrepresentation of Naija in AI models. It introduces the WARRI dataset as a new machine translation evaluation dataset for Naija and discusses the challenges of teaching LLMs to generate Naija texts.

type.justification: The paper involves empirical investigations using statistical analyses, machine translation experiments, and the introduction of a new dataset (WARRI) for evaluation, all of which are empirical methods.
type.quote: Through statistical analyses and Machine Translation experiments, our paper shows that these two pidgin varieties do not represent each other...
